checks.label: Pause control acknowledges stopped automatic motion
Pause choice survives refresh
Resume restores automatic presentation
Live reduced motion stops presentation and disables Resume
Live motion preference restores usable Pause/Resume
Selected floor remains visible during intermediate travel
Direct floor entry bypasses presentation into L2
Direct floor refresh retains L2 and map focus
Direct store refresh retains exact destination/floor/locale
Back restores selected store
Forward restores closed-store state
